question: Who among the following was one of the recipients of the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __Dr Amit Singh __

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Dr. Amit Singh have been conferred the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology, 2021, for biological science.
 
• The **Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize is one of the most prestigious awards in India for recognizing excellence in scientific research.**
 
• The **award is named after the founder Director of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR),** Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar.
 
• It is awarded annually by the CSIR for notable and outstanding research, applied or fundamental, in biological, chemical, earth, atmosphere, ocean and planetary, engineering, mathematical, medical, and physical sciences.
 
• The **prize comprises a citation, a plaque, and a cash award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Dr. Amit Singh is known for his work in the field of microbial pathogenesis and tuberculosis.
 
• Dr. Arun Kumar Shukla is recognized for his contributions to the understanding of G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) and their signaling mechanisms.
 
• The Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize was first awarded in 1958 and has since been awarded annually.
 
• The award aims to encourage and nurture young scientists to pursue high-quality research in their respective fields.
 
• Recipients of the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize often go on to receive further national and international recognition for their work.
